violation_type.title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment (26 TAC §746.2705(2))
violation_type.short_title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: During rest time, school age children were observed sleeping with there head down on a table instead of having a cot or mat to rest on.

finding_variants.text: During rest time, school age children were observed sleeping with there head down on a table instead of having a cot or mat to rest on.
It was found during naptime that school age children did not have appropriate nap or resting equipment.
Based on the evidence and information obtained during this investigation, it has been concluded that the operation failed to provide age-appropriate resting equipment to several school age children.
School-age children were observed resting on fabric and vinyl couches during quiet time and not personally assigned mats or cots.
During the investigation, it was noted school-aged children were napping on the class floor.
